items.markdown:
Copper peptides (such as GHK-Cu and AHK-Cu) `support hair growth by improving scalp health, boosting microcirculation, and signaling hair follicles to enter the growth phase` , though they work best as a supportive add-on rather than a standalone cure.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)[[2]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/what-are-copper-peptides-and-how-do-they-help-with-hair-growth)

- **Stimulate Follicles:** They signal dermal papilla cells to increase follicle size and encourage hairs to enter the anagen (growth) phase.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Juw69Q5YJqI&t=106)[[2]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/what-are-copper-peptides-and-how-do-they-help-with-hair-growth)
- **Improve Circulation:** They promote angiogenesis (building new tiny blood vessels) in the scalp to deliver more nutrients to roots.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XjheR9JV0DI&t=63)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)
- **Support Scalp Environment:** They boost collagen and elastin production while reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/what-are-copper-peptides-and-how-do-they-help-with-hair-growth)

### What to Expect & Limitations

- **Not FDA-Approved for Regrowth:** Copper peptides are cosmetic or supportive agents, not official pharmaceutical drugs like minoxidil or finasteride.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vSYqenc_nXI)[[2]](https://neuroganhealth.com/products/ghk-cu-copper-peptide-hair-and-scalp-serum)
- **They Don’t Block DHT:** They do not stop dihydrotestosterone (DHT), the primary hormone responsible for genetic hair miniaturization.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)
- **Timeline:** Visible improvements in thickness or reduced shedding typically take **3 to 6 months** of daily consistent application.[[1]](https://www.mdhair.co/article/the-truth-behind-copper-peptides-for-hair-care)[[2]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)
- **Synergy:** They layer well with treatments like minoxidil, micro-needling/derma-rolling, or botanical DHT blockers.
